Package controller

Class CompanyRepController

java.lang.Object
controller.CompanyRepController
public class CompanyRepController extends Object
Controller for handling all business logic for a Company Representative user. This class manages creating, editing, deleting, and viewing internships and applications that belong to the currently logged-in representative.
Version:
1.0

    • createInternship

      public boolean createInternship(String title, String description, String preferredMajor, InternshipLevel level, int maxSlot, LocalDate openDate, LocalDate closeDate)
      Creates a new internship and submits it for approval.
      Parameters:
      title - The internship title.
      description - The internship description.
      preferredMajor - The preferred major.
      level - The InternshipLevel.
      maxSlot - The number of available slots.
      openDate - The application opening date.
      closeDate - The application closing date.
      Returns:
      true if the internship was created, false if the representative has reached the 5 limit.

    • getEditableInternshipById

      public Internship getEditableInternshipById(int internshipId)
      Retrieves an internship for editing, but only if it is in PENDING status and belongs to the current rep. Prints error messages to console if validation fails.
      Parameters:
      internshipId - The ID of the internship to retrieve.
      Returns:
      The Internship object if editable, or null otherwise.

    • updateInternship

      public boolean updateInternship(int internshipId, String titleInput, String descInput, String majorInput, String levelInput, String slotInput, String openDateInput, String closeDateInput)
      Updates the details of a PENDING internship. Input strings of "-" are ignored.
      Parameters:
      internshipId - The ID of the internship to update.
      titleInput - The new title, or "-".
      descInput - The new description, or "-".
      majorInput - The new major, or "-".
      levelInput - The new level (as a String), or "-".
      slotInput - The new slot count (as a String), or "-".
      openDateInput - The new open date (as a String), or "-".
      closeDateInput - The new close date (as a String), or "-".
      Returns:
      true if successful, false if validation fails (e.g., bad date format, not PENDING status).

      public boolean deletePendingInternship(int internshipId)

      true if successful, false if the internship is not found or is not in PENDING status.
